description: A mosque 40 x 30 m with a main prayer hall for 1,200 men and a women's gallery upstairs for 300, entrances on the east and north.

spec.name: Mosque
assumptions: Main prayer hall uses 0.5 m² per person for standing prayer.
Women's gallery is a balcony along the south wall.
Stair to gallery is 1.2 m wide at west end.
No stage or barriers in prayer hall.
Total area fits 1,200 + 300 people with circulation.
